targetTest: turns commit_docs off and text_mode, intel and graphify on in staging, and `query commit` skips
expected: staging .planning/config.json holds commit_docs false, text_mode, intel and graphify true after the configure-gsd checkpoint
actual: the configure-gsd checkpoint is a no-op: staging has no .planning/config.json (ENOENT on the read)
semanticAssessment: chooseMappingMode is a stub returning internal; the workspace stage records no gsd:probe, mapping:plan or gsd:configure step and runs no GSD verb; the map stage always uses the full prompt and never stamps; onboard has no --mode flag. Each failing test therefore asserts a planned behaviour (decision table result, staging config values, step rows, prompt text, stamp call, usage error). Two tests pass on arrival and are legitimate regression guards: the full-map prompt/mode record (the existing behaviour) and no .planning created in a checkout that has none (staging-only behaviour already held because nothing ran GSD yet; it is mutation-checked after GREEN).
